div.div: فِرْزَانُ الشِطْرَنْجِ (K, TA) [The queen of the game of chess; or, as some say,] what occupies the place of the wezeer to the sultán [in that game]: (TA:) the former of these words is arabicized, from [the Pers.] فَرْزِين. (O and K in art. فرز, and K in the present art.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
